meta.name: false-green-tests
meta.description: Find out why the tests pass but the app is broken. Catches false greens: a green suite over a feature that does not work, a mocked API standing in for a real one, an assertion that holds no matter what the app does, a click handler wired to nothing. Use when the suite is green and the user says it is broken, when a test never fails, when coverage looks fine but bugs still ship, or before trusting a passing run you did not watch.

copy.tagline: 查出测试全绿但功能其实坏掉的原因,避免假绿灯蒙混过关
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果测试明明全过,线上却还是出问题
copy.tagline_en: Find out why tests pass while the app is broken
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your tests are green but the app still fails.

howto.what: 它会运行真实应用,把应用的实际行为和测试的断言逐条对比,找出「测试全绿但功能其实坏了」的假绿(如断言永不失败、只测了 mock),确认后改写那条漏掉问题的测试断言。
howto.when: 当测试全部通过但你反馈功能坏了、某个测试从不失败,或在信任一次你没亲眼看过的通过运行之前,它会接管。

say.text: 测试都绿了但登录按钮点了没反应,帮我查查是不是假绿。
say.note: 它会跑真实应用,拿实际行为和断言对比。

say.text: 这个测试从来没失败过,帮我看看它的断言是不是根本不可能失败。
say.note: 它会读那条测试并验证断言能不能失败。

say.text: 覆盖率看着挺好但线上还是出 bug,帮我做一遍点击扫描。
say.note: 它会跑 crawl 并返回发现的异常。

howto.what_en: It runs the real app and compares what the app actually does against what each test claims, confirming false greens (assertions that cannot fail, tests driven by mocks), then rewrites the assertion that missed it.
howto.when_en: Use when the suite is green but the user says it is broken, when a test never fails, or before trusting a passing run you did not watch.

say_en.text: All tests pass but the login button does nothing — is this a false green?
say_en.note: It runs the real app and compares it with the assertion.

say_en.text: This test has never failed — check whether its assertion can fail at all.
say_en.note: It reads that test and verifies the assertion.

say_en.text: Coverage looks fine but bugs still ship — run a click sweep on the app.
say_en.note: Runs crawl and returns the anomalies it finds.
